name: Oracle Nomad
body:
Constantly on the road, nomads migrate with the seasons and live in harmony with nature’s elements. As frontier foragers, nomads are most at home in the wild.

A nomad has the following class features.

Frontier Gear

A nomad is proficient with club, dagger, greatclub, handaxe, longbow, quarterstaff, shortbow, shortspear, sickle, sling, spear, throwing axe, non-metal light armor, hide, and wooden shields (except tower shields).

This alters weapon and armor proficiency.

Nature Savvy

A nomad must select the nature, stone, wind, or wood mystery.

Furthermore, a nomad uses the following bonus spells in place of her mystery’s bonus spells: Bonus Spells: goodberry (2nd), resist energy (4th), longstrider, greater (6th), life bubble (8th), cleanse APG (10th), transport via plants (12th), sunbeam (14th), stormbolts (16th), ride the lightning (18th).

This alters mystery.

Wild-Bonded

A nomad draws her spells from the druid spell list. A nomad automatically adds the cure/inflict spells to her spells known at a slower rate than a typical oracle because these spells appear on the druid spell list at later levels than on the cleric spell list. (At 2nd level there is no “cure” spell on the druid spell list, therefore a nomad adds lesser restoration at this level.) Nomads, however, utilize various medicinal plants along migratory routes as additional components when casting cure/inflict spells to increase the power of these spells. A nomad adds her nomad spell casting ability score modifier to the number of hit points she cures.

This alters spells.

Nature’s Wisdom

The wisdom of nature itself fuels a nomad’s power. A nomad uses her Wisdom rather than her Charisma to determine her spell casting ability and all class features.

This alters spells, revelations, and class features which reference Charisma.

On the Road

A nomad adds the following revelations to her list of revelations from which she can select:

Tongue of the Natives (Su)

You are exposed to a variety of languages in your travels; you gain one bonus language upon selecting this revelation, and whenever you invest a rank in Linguistics, you gain two languages rather than one.

At 3rd level, as a free action, you can act as though under the effects of comprehend languages for a number of rounds per day equal to your oracle level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

At 7th level, add the bonus spell tongues to your spells known list which does not count against your maximum allotment.

Weathered (Ex)

Constant exposure to the elements on the road has thickened your skin. You gain a +1 innate bonus to your natural armor class. This bonus increases by +1 for every four oracle levels you possess.

Wilderness Wanderer (Ex)

You encounter a variety of indigenous flora and fauna in your travels; knowing which are safe and which to avoid can be the difference between surviving or perishing. You add your nomad spell-casting ability modifier to all Knowledge skill checks when identifying strengths and weaknesses of monsters. Beginning at 3rd level, if you make a successful Knowledge skill check to determine a monster’s strengths and weaknesses, you gain a +1 insight bonus on attack and damage rolls against that creature type for 10 minutes. These bonuses increase to +2 at 10th level.

This alters revelations.

Nomad’s Stride

Upon reaching 20th level, you travel the wilderness with ease, ignoring extremes of temperature, terrain impediments, and hostile creatures. You are constantly under the effects of endure elements and freedom of movement. When you successfully determine a monster’s strengths and weaknesses with your wilderness wanderer ability, you use your character level rather than your oracle level to determine your base attack bonus for attacks against that creature type for 1 minute.

This replaces final revelation.
